description: This is a shell script used to determine and output the version information of a project, by checking for version files or retrieving revision info from version control systems (git or hg).

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a local 'version' file and reads its contents if present.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Attempts to determine revision info from a git repository, supporting different revision specification formats.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Attempts to determine revision info from a Mercurial repository.
